title: Talk where the work happens
body: Suppliers, the team and the AI teammates share one set of conversations, and every message is part of the plan.

title: A supplier writes, the plan updates
body: Murugan types an update the way he always would. Shuttle reads it and moves the order forward on its own, quoting the message.

title: No one retyped anything
body: PO-017 is already in Stitching on the production board, linked back to Murugan's message.

title: Chat with a teammate
body: Ask Shuttle anything about production. It answers from the live plan, and See why shows how.

title: Mention a teammate in any thread
body: In #ops, the team tags @weft and gets an answer in place, without leaving the conversation.
